# Execution Task: Add Python 3 greeting module with tests and README section

## Scope
- One small Node in the selected controlled Project `delivery-acceptance-project-v1`, using the selected Role and the repository resource `delivery-acceptance-repo-v1` (default branch `main`).
- Confine all work to that repository; preserve every existing repository file and behavior.

## Deliverables
1. `greeting.py` (Python 3 module, repository root)
   - Expose `greeting(name: str) -> str`.
   - Strip leading and trailing whitespace from `name`.
   - If the stripped result is nonempty, return `"Hello, <name>!"` with the stripped name substituted literally.
   - If the stripped result is empty or whitespace-only, return `"Hello, friend!"`.
   - Preserve Unicode names as literal text: no normalization, encoding conversion, or transliteration of the name.

2. `tests/test_greeting.py`
   - Meaningful tests using only the Python 3 standard library (`unittest`).
   - Cover at least: a normal name, a name with leading/trailing whitespace (trimmed), blank and whitespace-only names (friend case), and a Unicode name preserved literally.
   - No third-party dependencies.

3. `README.md`
   - Add an additive section (do not remove or alter existing content) that documents the module and includes the exact command:
     `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`

## Constraints
- Do not change `.github/workflows`.
- The function must have no network or filesystem side effects.
- No new dependencies; no credentials; do not publish private execution history.
- Keep the change to one small Node; do not create additional Tasks or Nodes.

## Acceptance check
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` runs green using only the standard library.
- All pre-existing repository files and behavior remain intact.

# Execution Task: Add farewell.py with unittest tests and README documentation

## Summary
In the controlled acceptance repository delivery-acceptance-repo-v1 (project delivery-acceptance-project-v1, default branch main, default ref aa274b45f50c514ed1be500473bc4a284325f375), add a new top-level module farewell.py exposing a pure farewell(name: str) -> str function, add meaningful standard-library unittest tests under a tests/ directory, and add an additive README section documenting the literal command `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`. Preserve all existing files and behavior. Add no dependencies. Do not change .github/workflows. Keep the implementation to one small Node.

## Requirements

### 1. farewell.py (new file at repository root)
- Define farewell(name: str) -> str as a pure function:
  - Trim surrounding whitespace from the input name (e.g., name.strip()).
  - If the trimmed name is nonempty, return "Goodbye, <name>!" using the trimmed name.
  - If the trimmed name is blank (empty or whitespace-only), return "Goodbye, friend!".
  - Preserve Unicode characters exactly (no transliteration, no ASCII folding, no encoding changes).
  - Perform no filesystem or network I/O. Use only the Python standard library.

### 2. Tests (new files under tests/)
- Add meaningful standard-library unittest tests covering at least:
  - Nonempty name returns "Goodbye, <name>!".
  - Blank name returns "Goodbye, friend!".
  - Surrounding whitespace is trimmed from the name.
  - Unicode characters in names are preserved.
- The tests must be discoverable and runnable by the literal command `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`.

### 3. README documentation (additive)
- Append an additive README section that documents the literal command `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` (for example, a "Running tests" section). Do not remove or alter existing README content.

### 4. Constraints
- Preserve all existing files and behavior.
- Add no dependencies (no third-party packages; standard library only).
- Do not change .github/workflows or any CI workflow files.
- The function must not perform filesystem or network I/O.
- Implementation is confined to one small Node; no additional Nodes.

## Definition of Done
- farewell.py exists at the repository root and defines the pure farewell function with the behavior above.
- tests/ contains meaningful standard-library unittest tests.
- README contains an additive section with the literal command `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passes.
- All existing files and behavior are preserved; no dependencies added; .github/workflows unchanged.
